## 3. Findings

| ID | Severity | Area | Finding | Impact | Recommendation | Decision | Status |
|----|----------|------|---------|--------|----------------|----------|--------|
| DR-001 | **High** | Dependencies | `sqlalchemy` and `psycopg2` are absent from `requirements.txt`. The app will fail to start on a clean install. | Blocks all testing and deployment | Add `sqlalchemy` and `psycopg2-binary` to `requirements.txt` | ✅ Accepted — add both packages as DR-001 | Resolved |
| DR-002 | **High** | Testability | Architecture does not describe a test database strategy. Existing tests use `TestClient` + JSON files with no DB. The new `GET /vehicles/{vehicle_id}` tests require a live database or a properly overridden `get_db` dependency. Without this, tests will either fail or couple to a live PostgreSQL instance. | Test suite fails on CI without a real DB; risks integration gaps | Override `get_db` in tests using a SQLite in-memory database via FastAPI dependency override | ✅ Accepted — use SQLite in-memory DB for tests via `app.dependency_overrides[get_db]` (DR-002) | Resolved |
| DR-003 | **Medium** | API Contract | Open Question OQ-1 (whether `id` is included in `VehicleResponse`) is unresolved. An undefined response contract makes downstream tests and consumers ambiguous. | Ambiguous acceptance criterion | Resolve OQ-1: AC-001 lists exactly six attributes (make, model, year, price, transmission, fuel_type); `id` is not in the acceptance criterion. Exclude `id` from `VehicleResponse` | ✅ Accepted — `VehicleResponse` contains the six AC-001 attributes only; `id` excluded (DR-003) | Resolved |
| DR-004 | **Medium** | Resource Management | Architecture mentions `get_db` dependency but does not specify that the session generator must use `try/finally` to guarantee `session.close()` on both success and exception paths. Without this, DB connections leak under errors. | Connection pool exhaustion under load or test failures | `get_db()` generator must follow the canonical pattern: `db = SessionLocal(); try: yield db; finally: db.close()` | ✅ Accepted — planner and implementer must use try/finally pattern (DR-004) | Resolved |
| DR-005 | **Low** | Schema Clarity | The `vehicles` table schema is described only in prose (Section 6 of architecture). No formal column types or constraints are stated, which may cause ambiguity during implementation. | Minor implementation ambiguity | Add a formal column-type table to `artifacts/architecture.md` | ✅ Accepted — architecture.md updated in Section 6 below | Resolved |
| DR-006 | **Low** | ORM Model | Open Question OQ-2 (Alembic / migration tool) is noted but unresolved. Planner needs to know whether to include table creation steps in test setup. | Test setup ambiguity | For this story, tests create the schema using `Base.metadata.create_all(engine)` against the SQLite in-memory DB. Alembic is deferred as out of scope. | ✅ Accepted — tests use `create_all`; Alembic deferred (DR-006) | Resolved |

## 4. Agreed Design Decisions

| ID | Decision | Rationale |
|----|----------|-----------|
| DR-001 | Add `sqlalchemy==1.4.*` and `psycopg2-binary` to `requirements.txt` | Required for SQLAlchemy ORM and PostgreSQL connectivity; `psycopg2-binary` chosen for ease of installation |
| DR-002 | Test database strategy: override `get_db` using SQLite in-memory via `app.dependency_overrides` in `test/test_vehicle.py` | Keeps tests fast, hermetic, and CI-friendly without requiring a live PostgreSQL instance |
| DR-003 | `VehicleResponse` Pydantic schema includes exactly: make, model, year, price, transmission, fuel_type — no `id` | AC-001 lists exactly these six attributes; exclusion of `id` is consistent with the acceptance criterion |
| DR-004 | `get_db()` dependency generator pattern: `db = SessionLocal(); try: yield db; finally: db.close()` | Prevents connection leaks on all code paths including exceptions |
| DR-005 | Formal column types added to architecture: id (Integer PK), make (String), model (String), year (Integer), price (Numeric), transmission (String), fuel_type (String) | Removes implementation ambiguity; provides unambiguous mapping for ORM model |
| DR-006 | Tests create schema with `Base.metadata.create_all(engine)` against in-memory SQLite; Alembic deferred | Scope-appropriate for a single-endpoint story; Alembic adds complexity beyond FR-001 |

## 6. Required Updates to `artifacts/architecture.md`

The following amendment is applied to Section 6 (New Files and Changes) to add formal column types per DR-005:

### Vehicle Table Schema (amendment to architecture Section 3.2)

| Column | Type | Constraint | Notes |
|--------|------|------------|-------|
| `id` | Integer | PRIMARY KEY | Auto-increment |
| `make` | String(100) | NOT NULL | e.g. "Toyota" |
| `model` | String(100) | NOT NULL | e.g. "Corolla" |
| `year` | Integer | NOT NULL | e.g. 2022 |
| `price` | Numeric(12,2) | NOT NULL | e.g. 24999.99 |
| `transmission` | String(50) | NOT NULL | e.g. "automatic" |
| `fuel_type` | String(50) | NOT NULL | e.g. "petrol" |

### Test Strategy Amendment (addition to architecture Section 6)

| Action | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| **Modify** | `requirements.txt` | Add `sqlalchemy==1.4.*` and `psycopg2-binary` |
| **Create** | `test/test_vehicle.py` | Override `get_db` with SQLite in-memory engine; create schema with `Base.metadata.create_all`; seed a Vehicle row; assert 200 response; assert 404 on missing ID |
